output_list.reason: The mintToken function has an integer overflow that allows the owner to set the balance of an arbitrary user to any value.
The transfer function allows the attacker to set any user as the recipient of a trade, including the owner.
The transferFrom function uses the balance of the owner as a safety measure, but it does not properly randomize the address of the user that is allowed to access the owner's funds.
The approve function allows the owner to set the spending allowance of an attacker.
The freezeAccount function allows the owner to set any user as the recipient of a trade, including the owner.
The changeName function allows the owner to set the name of the contract, which is a major vulnerability.
The changeSymbol function allows the owner to set the symbol of the contract, which is a major vulnerability.
The changeDecimals function allows the owner to set the decimal units of the contract, which is a major vulnerability.
